parameters.name: AutoTraceEnabled
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable lineage-based automatic backtracking.

parameters.name: DataAssetType
parameters.description:
The type of the data asset. Valid values:

*   ACS::DataWorks::Table
*   ACS::DataWorks::Task

parameters.name: EnvType
parameters.description:
The environment of the workspace to which the data asset belongs. Valid values:

*   Dev: development environment
*   Prod: production environment

parameters.name: Tags
parameters.description: The tags that you want to add to data assets.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dataworks-public tag-data-assets --tags Value=value Key=key --data-asset-ids 7259557000 --data-asset-type ACS::DataWorks::Task --project-id 10000 --env-type Prod --auto-trace-enabled false --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dataworks-public TagDataAssets --region cn-hangzhou --AutoTraceEnabled false --ProjectId 10000 --DataAssetIds '["7259557000"]' --DataAssetType 'ACS::DataWorks::Task' --Tags '[{"Value":"value","Key":"key"}]' --EnvType Prod
